sole_research_target_confirmation: The sole research target is the FULL arbitrary-dimension quadratic-form bounded-density conjecture with independent cap-one marginals and at least three eigenvalues of modulus at least one.
exact_scope: Exact equality of the full optimal density constant with the constant on compactly supported smooth cap-one marginals and fully generic symmetric matrices having simple spectrum, all nonempty principal minors nonzero, and strict >1 protected spectral margin. first_unproved_step: Obtain a matrix- and dimension-independent density height on that regular subclass without paying tiny principal minors or smoothness/support parameters.
next_mathematical_attempt: Use the regular-class reduction to isolate and attack the complementary high-leverage heavy-coordinate regime left by the ridge-window theorem, retaining original-coordinate product structure.
